purpose: Planning evidence only; not a production admission policy.

merged_prs.population: latest 100 merged PR records returned by GitHub CLI

local_commits.population: latest 100 first-parent non-merge commits at repository HEAD
local_commits.query: git log --first-parent --no-merges --format='%H' -100; git show --numstat per commit

test_workflows.population: latest 50 tests.yml runs; completed success/failure runs only

hermes_sessions.population: session JSON objects excluding _index.json, updated in the preceding 172800 seconds
hermes_sessions.interpretation: Harness replay evidence; not a local staged-work budget.

integrity.raw_query_payloads: not retained; canonical query hashes and commands are recorded above
integrity.limitation: latest-N queries drift and the recorded hashes cannot be independently recomputed without the omitted member lists
integrity.required_before_policy_use: retain immutable member identities, bounded raw aggregates, and the derivation script
integrity.policy_authority: none; this receipt cannot authorize release
